blockers.sought: Instead of minimums China has maximums: since August 2018 nine major producers and the three largest streaming platforms (iQiyi, Youku, Tencent) agreed that actors' pay may not exceed 40% of a production's budget, the leads may take no more than 70% of total cast pay, and an actor may earn at most 50 million yuan for a whole TV series and 1 million yuan an episode, after authorities including the China Film Administration called for curbs on exorbitant pay. (Finding withdrawn 2026-11-01: its only source, China Daily, 13 August 2018, rests on the joint statement of three platforms and six production companies (关于抑制不合理片酬，抵制行业不正风气的联合声明, 11 August 2018), which names no published primary; it lands again on the statement's own published text, or the State Administration of Radio and Television's notice setting the 40% and 70% caps.)
